name: 陳宥寧
objective:
自第七週起，本課程將介紹人工智慧於氣候變遷調適與災害管理之應用，內容涵蓋氣候 AI 與災害 AI 的國際發展趨勢、責任 AI 治理、天氣預報、災害預警、氣候資料判讀、淹水與都市熱島分析、機器學習、水風險，以及企業氣候風險管理。課程結合理論講授、案例討論、數位工具操作與線上自主學習，培養學生運用 AI 及空間分析工具理解氣候風險、判讀災害資訊，並提出調適策略之基礎能力。
From Week 7 onwards, this course introduces the applications of artificial intelligence in climate change adaptation and disaster management. Topics include global trends in Climate AI and Disaster AI, responsible AI governance, weather forecasting, disaster early warning, climate-data interpretation, flood and urban heat island analysis, machine learning, water risk, and corporate climate-risk management. Through lectures, case discussions, digital-tool exercises, and online self-directed learning, students will develop fundamental skills in applying AI and spatial-analysis tools to understand climate risks, interpret disaster information, and propose adaptation strategies.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1~6：Dr. Tseng

Week 7：國際氣候 AI、災害 AI 與責任 AI 治理趨勢
Global Trends in Climate AI, Disaster AI and Responsible AI Governance

Week 8：AI 天氣預報、災害預警與災害監測工具 
AI Weather Forecasting, Disaster Early Warning and Monitoring Tools

Week 9：期中考試 (Dr. Tseng)
Midterm Examination (Dr. Tseng)

Week 10：氣候資料、升溫情境與調適需求判讀
Climate Data, Warming Scenarios and Adaptation Needs

Week 11：Google Earth Engine 與 UN - SPIDER 淹水範圍判釋
Google Earth Engine and UN - SPIDER Flood Mapping

Week 12：QGIS、都市熱島、NDVI 與綠覆率調適分析
QGIS, Urban Heat Island, NDVI and Green Coverage Analysis

Week 13：AI 機器學習入門：災害脆弱度分群與影像辨識
Introductory AI: Vulnerability Clustering and Disaster Image Classification

Week 14：水風險、企業氣候風險與 AI 排放追蹤
Water Risk, Corporate Climate Risk and AI-based Emissions Tracking

Week 15：期末考試
Final Examination

Week 16：聖誕節／國定假日
Christmas / National Holiday

Week 17：彈性學習週／Flexible Learning
(元旦／國定假日 New Year’s Day / National Holiday)

Week 18：彈性學習週／Flexible Learning

remarks:
本課程導入 AI 輔助學習與開放資料工具，包含生成式 AI、氣候 AI、災害 AI、調適 AI、GIS、遙測與氣候資料平台等。修課同學可於課堂實作與個人作業中使用 AI 工具輔助資料蒐集、案例分析、圖資判讀與文字整理，但不得直接複製 AI 產出作為個人作業答案。所有 AI 產出均須進行原始資料查證、人工判斷與必要修正，並於作業中註明使用之工具、資料來源、操作方式及 AI 可能產生之限制或錯誤。本課程亦將說明 AI 幻覺、資料偏誤、模型不確定性、可解釋性、公平性、問責性與責任 AI 治理等議題。

name: 曾昭衡
objective:
全球暖化與氣候變遷已對人類社會造成面臨前所未有的挑戰。不論是哪個國家，都遭受其帶來的影響。IPCC 報告中，諸多科學證據證實氣候變遷已是不可改變的事實，為了世界環境的永續發展，「減緩」與「調適」是現階段順應氣候變遷積極採取的方式。我國臺灣舉凡環境及氣候條件隸屬於氣候變遷高危險群，極端氣候事件，例如熱浪、颱風、洪水… 等皆逐漸嚴重影響，因此，防減災與氣候變遷調適相對更加重要。其中氣候變遷調適更是能夠面對未來氣候可能產生的衝擊，透過周延的規畫以適應充滿挑戰與變化的新環境。因此本課程針對國際與我國減少災害風險與氣候變遷調適介紹，並探討其各中因應方式與困境等課題，期藉培養與提高對氣候變遷防減災與氣候變遷調適的認識。
Global warming and climate change are the biggest challenges to human society. With current warming trend proceeds at an unprecedented rate, climate change poses a threat to all countries. In the IPCC assessment reports, much of scientific evidence indicates climate change an unalterable fact, so in order to meet the needs of present generations without jeopardizing the ability of futures generations to meet their own need, approaches on "mitigation" and "adaptation" needed to be adopted in response to climate change. 
Taiwan is vulnerable and at high risk to climate change because of geographic exposure and climatic conditions. Extreme weather events, such as heat wave, typhoon, and flood, bring catastrophic damages in Taiwan.
